areas.label: Boarding point: the kill-gangway
areas.desc: Where the keepers' line and gangway reach the Unspent. Goldwake's trap: planks drop out over open air.

areas.label: Top deck and swivel guns
areas.desc: Swivel guns rigged to fire at whoever crosses. The Ninehulls fight happens here.

areas.label: The wing-sails
areas.desc: Open air on both sides. Anyone shoved off the rail falls toward Freeboard.

areas.label: Star skylight
areas.desc: The skylight over Goldwake's cabin, blacked from inside. Halfers swear they've seen lamplight here.

areas.label: Stern stairs
areas.desc: Curved stairs down to the cabin deck.
